name: electrondb
description: ElectronDB: private Navicat-compatible desktop MySQL client (connections, object explorer, query editor, .nb3 backups and automation).
author: Y0rshB3

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/seed-screenshots.mjs && npm run build && ELECTRONDB_USER_DATA=${ELECTRONDB_SHOTS_PROFILE:-${NAVIDOG_SHOTS_PROFILE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/electrondb-shots/profile}} ELECTRONDB_PLAIN_SECRETS=1 ELECTRONDB_UPDATES_FIXTURE=${ELECTRONDB_UPDATES_FIXTURE:-tests/fixtures/updates/latest-release.json} ELECTRONDB_WHATS_NEW_FROM=${ELECTRONDB_WHATS_NEW_FROM:-0.1.2} ELECTRONDB_WHATS_NEW_VERSION=${ELECTRONDB_WHATS_NEW_VERSION:-0.1.4} ELECTRONDB_SCREENSHOTS=${ELECTRONDB_SHOTS_DIR:-${NAVIDOG_SHOTS_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/electrondb-shots}} npx electron .
